d:
[Branded Content] Some nights, the story refuses to come to you. So you get on your motorcycle and go looking for it. Anant sets off on the TVS Raider in search of coffee, only to find a city full of strange signs, questionable directions and encounters that make him question his decisions.
As the night gets stranger, the Raider's features come into their own, from Power Mode and Traction Control to GTT and TFT navigation. And just when Anant thinks he has reached the end of his caffeine-fuelled adventure, the night saves its strangest surprise for last.
